tools.name: search_ontology_terms
tools.description:
Search for ontology terms in BioPortal.

This function searches across BioPortal ontologies for terms matching the given query.
It returns a list of tuples containing the term ID, preferred label, ontology, and ontology URL.

ontologies.description:
Comma-separated list of ontology acronyms to search in (e.g., "NCIT,GO,HP").
       If None, searches across all ontologies.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).

require_exact_match.description: If True, only return exact matches (default: False).

api_key.description: BioPortal API key. If not provided, uses BIOPORTAL_API_KEY environment variable.

tools.name: search_ontology_properties
tools.description:
Search for ontology properties in BioPortal.

This function searches for ontology properties (object properties, annotation properties, 
datatype properties) by their labels and IDs across BioPortal ontologies.

query.description: The search term (e.g., "has part", "related to", "has dimension").

ontologies.description:
Comma-separated list of ontology acronyms to search in (e.g., "NCIT,GO,HP").
       If None, searches across all ontologies.

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 10).

require_exact_match.description: If True, only return exact matches by property id, label, or generated label (default: False).

require_definitions.description: If True, only return properties that have definitions (default: False).

property_types.description:
Comma-separated list of property types to filter by: "object", "annotation", "datatype".
           If None, returns all property types.

api_key.description: BioPortal API key. If not provided, uses BIOPORTAL_API_KEY environment variable.

tools.name: get_ontology_analytics
tools.description:
Get visitor analytics for BioPortal ontologies.

This function retrieves Google Analytics data for ontology visits. You can get analytics
for all ontologies, filter by month/year, or get detailed analytics for a specific ontology.

ontology_acronym.description:
Ontology acronym to get analytics for (e.g., "NCIT", "GO").
             If None, returns analytics for all ontologies.

month.description: Month number (1-12) to filter analytics. Only valid when ontology_acronym is None.

year.description: Year to filter analytics (e.g., 2024). Only valid when ontology_acronym is None.

api_key.description: BioPortal API key. If not provided, uses BIOPORTAL_API_KEY environment variable.
